success_criteria.S1: lossless decode of every coded stream
success_criteria.S2: freeze commit and frozen candidate manifest precede sealed data; overlap audit passes
success_criteria.S3: identical symbol stream digest for every candidate and coder
success_criteria.S4: per coder, every sealed file and crumb: |overhead_ub - 448000000| <= 64000000 + 1000 x N
success_criteria.S5: no unexplained material reversal (FAILURE_REPORTING.md section 5): DL ordering reversal ideal vs coder explained iff |ideal DL gap| <= 2 x band(g); material T sign reversal ideal vs coder explained iff |T_ideal - T_coded| <= 2 x band(g); material T sign reversal group 1 vs group 2 never explained; no cause label is preregistered, so an unexplained reversal is FAIL whatever cause is found later; band(g) = sum over files of (64000000 + 1000 x N_f) ub
success_criteria.S6: group 1: lower bound of T(M_candidate) > 0, ideal and both coders
success_criteria.S7: group 1: upper bound of T(M_mem) < 0 and of T(M_mem_seed1) < 0, ideal and both coders
success_criteria.S8: independent scorer (lane D, EVALUATOR.md section 6) reproduces every number exactly and reports problems 0; its file missing, unreadable or reporting problems is S8 FAIL with no retry

verdict_rule.inconclusive_trigger: S6: PASS if every lower bound > 0, FAIL if any upper bound < 0, else INCONCLUSIVE. S7: PASS if every upper bound (both memorizers) < 0, FAIL if any lower bound > 0, else INCONCLUSIVE. S9: worse of the S6 and S7 rules on group 2. Intervals: 95% percentile bootstrap of T vs B2, ideal and both coders.
verdict_rule.not_reached: a criterion that cannot be evaluated is NOT_REACHED and counts as FAIL
verdict_rule.verdict: FAIL if any criterion FAIL or NOT_REACHED; else INCONCLUSIVE if any INCONCLUSIVE; else PASS; a refused check is classified by the refusal table in EVALUATOR.md section 3 (the one classification; FAILURE_REPORTING.md and this file restate it): VOID only for an infrastructure failure before any sealed score exists (a void row), a terminal FAIL of the named criterion otherwise (for example BINDING S3, freeze order S2, CRUMB_SUM S4, NO_CRUMBS S6 or S9, lane D missing or problems S8), and no receipt for an argument, location or ended-experiment refusal

stopping_rule: fixed design, no optional stopping (2 groups x 3 seeds, each scored once); a generation failure voids the attempt, not the experiment: it is retried with the same C_f, seeds, frozen tree and byte-identical command; generation, frozen-tree tests and evaluation share one void counter in $TC_EVAL_ROOT/<C_f>/run/bundle and the third void ends EXP-001 as INCONCLUSIVE (INFRA); generation requires the freeze receipt on origin/main (profile stopping_rule, BLINDING_PROTOCOL.md steps 4 to 8)

coders.envelope: two-sided, per coder, per file and per crumb: |overhead - 448| <= 64 + 1.0e-3 x N bits; slope measured on dev seeds 1-7, not proven; rANS codes below ideal on skewed low-index rows
